headline: Arte Abierto / Sordo Madaleno Arquitectos
context: Arte Abierto Baja opens in Los Cabos, introducing a new public art gallery to the region. Designed by Sordo Madaleno at Ánima Village, the open-air gallery brings Mexican and international artists into direct dialogue with Baja California Sur's landscape.
